title_zh: 周报 | IBM发布迄今最快量子处理器Nighthawk r2，每秒执行超10万个电路；Xanadu更新路线图，计划到2031年实现超1000个逻辑量子比特...
text_zh:
IBM发布Nighthawk r2，
每秒可执行超10万个电路
8月31日，IBM发布了Nighthawk r2，一款120量子比特处理器，迄今为止最快的量子处理器，采用新的量子比特复位系统，旨在通过大幅加速的量子比特重置实现更有价值的计算。该处理器每秒可执行超过10万个电路，吞吐量是IBM的Heron系统的25倍，同时保持相当的门极精度。Nighthawk r2已在包含超过7500个门的电路上实现了准确估计，并支持量子纠错研究的电路内复位。
来源：
https://www.ibm.com/quantum/blog/nighthawk-r2
Xanadu更新技术路线图，计划到2031年实现超1000个逻辑量子比特
8月31日，Xanadu已制定了更新的技术路线图，目标是在2028-2029年实现容错量子计算，并在2031年前实现超过1000个逻辑量子比特。该路线图目标是将公司光子损失指标从2026年的24.1倍降至2030年的1.0倍，同时将逻辑错误率提升至10⁻¹⁶。Xanadu还计划在2029年至2030年间建设一个量子数据中心，并将PennyLane软件平台扩展到量子硬件和仿真环境。
来源：
https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/08/31/3353211/0/en/xanadu-charts-path-to-over-1-000-logical-qubits-by-2031.html
美国国会议员提出《美国量子竞争力法案》，推动量子技术发展
8月31日，美国国会议员尼克·兰沃西（Nick Langworthy）提出《美国量子竞争力法案》，以加强美国量子商业化、制造和国内供应链。该法案将指定商务部为联邦商业量子技术的负责机构，并要求制定国家竞争力战略。该立法强调减少对外国对手的依赖，
支持纽约
I-90技术走廊沿线的先进制造业。
来源：
https://langworthy.house.gov/media/press-releases/congressman-langworthy-introduces-american-quantum-competitiveness-act
iAccess Partners
与
QAI Ventures
合作，促进量子与先进计算企业准入
8月29日，瑞士金融科技公司
iAccess Partners与总部位于巴塞尔的风险投资公司QAI Ventures建立战略合作伙伴关系，旨在扩大对早期量子技术和先进计算投资的可及性。通过利用可银行化的国际证券识别码（ISINs），该合作将合格和专业投资者的最低投资门槛降至25000美元。
来源：
https://qai-ventures.com/news/qai-ventures-partners-with-iacess-partners
国光量子获数千万元
A++
轮投资，加速光子集成量子计算
8月29日
消息
，
近日，北京中科国光量子科技有限公司（国光量子）再获数千万元战略融资，由国家级新区郑州航空港经济综合实验区管委会下属基金领投。双方将以
“光子集成量子计算”为核心抓手，实现技术、资本与产业资源的深度协同，紧扣国家量子科技发展战略，加速核心技术攻关与多行业场景落地，共建量子产业创新生态。
来源：
https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/jNFVOxGxhQAkE_0yX3HEiQ
国腾量子发布全栈自研
“光纵横”量子计算机，采用五层系统架构
8月30日，第八届粤港澳大湾区（广东）量子密码与信息安全高峰论坛暨第五届港澳青年精英圆桌论坛在广州举办。会上，广东国腾量子科技有限公司正式发布全栈自研“光纵横”量子计算机，其采用全栈自研的五层系统架构，实现从底层硬件到顶层应用的完全自主可控。同时，同步揭牌量子经纬枢纮829实验室、启动Q-Gate开源社区，构建起“硬件底座-系统软件-开发生态”的完整产业闭环。
来源：
https://www.stdaily.com/web/gdxw/2026-08/30/content_572134.html
Anyon Systems与KMT Technologies宣布合作，扩大量子计算部署
8月31日，Anyon Systems与KMT Technologies建立战略合作伙伴关系，以扩大
Anyon
超导量子计算系统的国际部署。
KMT
将作为
Anyon
在部分国际市场的独家代理和分销商，提供安装、集成、服务和支持。此次合作结合了Anyon的量子计算技术与Matrix集团在高性能计算（HPC）、人工智能基础设施、数据中心、网络和系统集成方面的专业知识。
来源：
https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/anyon-systems-and-matrix-group-announce-strategic-partnership-to-accelerate-international-deployment-of-quantum-computing-302865069.html
QTREX将在IEEE量子周发布17280线低温互连架构
8月31日，QTREX宣布计划在IEEE量子周2026上发布超高密度互连架构，支持全尺寸商业系统中每个低温阶段最多17280条同轴线路。公司将展示一个物理系统，在稀释冰箱的多个温度阶段中重现建筑密度。QTREX计划在活动后启动配置项目，开发针对量子处理器、低温器、通道需求、热预算和性能规格量身定制的互连系统。
来源：
https://ir.q-trex.com/press-releases/qtex-20260831-correction-qtrex-establishes-cryogenic-interconnect-capacity?title=Correction%3A%20QTREX%20Establishes%20Cryogenic%20Interconnect%20Capacity%2C%20More%20Than%20Four%20Times%20the%20Highest%20Publicly%20Disclosed%20Industry%20Benchmark%20&date=2026-08-31&source=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.globenewswire.com%2Fnews-release%2F2026%2F08%2F31%2F3353393%2F0%2Fen%2Fcorrection-qtrex-establishes-cryogenic-interconnect-capacity-more-than-four-times-the-highest-publicly-disclosed-industry-benchmark.html
Diffraqtion宣布筹集超1000万美元，加速量子相机开发
8月31日，Diffraqtion宣布获得洛克希德·马丁风险投资和Presidio Ventures的战略投资，使其总融资额超过1000万美元。麻省理工学院和马里兰大学的衍生公司
Diffraqtion
通过空中演示、DARPA SBIR项目和NASA项目推进了其量子相机技术。Diffraqtion计划利用新资金开发其首个现场相机，计划将有效载荷搭载在合作航天器上，提供飞行传承。
来源：
https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/lockheed-martin-ventures-and-sumitomos-presidio-ventures-back-diffraqtion-302864959.html
Pasqal与KACST启动合作，聚焦量子及后量子密码领域
8月31日，KACST与Pasqal签署了一项研究协议，推动量子技术研究并开发沙特阿拉伯的量子安全密码解决方案。此次合作将Pasqal的中性原子量子计算技术和云服务与KACST国家量子技术中心结合起来，主要聚焦量子密码学。该协议扩大了Pasqal在沙特阿拉伯的业务，继与阿美的合作及与Eleven Ventures合作计划在沙特及更广泛的中东北非地区部署和商业化量子计算系统之后。
来源：
https://www.pasqal.com/newsroom/pasqal-and-kacst-launch-strategic-quantum-research-collaboration-as-pasqal-expands-presence-in-saudi-arabia/
Quantinuum与阿美签署非约束性谅解备忘录，探索工业量子计算
8月31日，Quantinuum与阿美签署了一份非约束性谅解备忘录，旨在探索容错量子计算的工业应用及潜在的研究合作。两家公司计划识别适合量子计算研究的能源和数字化转型挑战，并对不同的量子计算模式进行基准测试。协议还涵盖了技术入职和知识交流，阿美评估未来量子系统如何解决科学和工业问题。
来源：
https://www.quantinuum.com/press-releases/quantinuum-signs-non-binding-mou-with-aramco-to-explore-synergies-leveraging-industrial-quantum-computing-research-applications-and-expertise#
S-Transistors筹集260万欧元的预种子轮，推出超导晶体管平台
8月31日，芬兰初创公司S-Transistors宣布筹集了260万欧元，用于开发超导晶体管电路，旨在帮助量子计算机更高效地扩展。
S-Transistors
计划开发产品原型，建立低温实验室和制造试验线，并扩充团队。其首款产品将是多路复用器，旨在降低低温系统中控制量子器件时的布线和功率需求。
来源：
https://www.vttresearch.com/en/news-and-ideas/s-transistors-raises-eu26-million-pre-seed-round-introduce-unique-superconducting
Yaqumo入选
NEDO项目
，与
SCREEN Holdings合作开发国产光学元件和模块
8月31日，Yaqumo被选中参与NEDO项目，并将与SCREEN Holdings合作，开发国产的光学元件和模块，用于大规模中性原子量子计算机。该项目将聚焦于高速空间光调制器、多波长物镜、环境稳定的光学元件以及采用光子集成电路的更紧凑系统。Yaqumo计划将该技术整合到自身系统中，同时追求标准化模块，供日本及海外的量子计算机开发者使用。
来源：
https://yaqumo.com/en/news/464/
SEALSQ披露2450万美元量子计算投资组合，以服务主权量子垂直栈战略
8月31日，SEALSQ披露已向法国硅自旋量子企业Quobly投入约1750万美元，并向电子悬浮液氦路线企业EeroQ投入700万美元。这些资产合计约为2450万美元的战略敞口，涉及基于SEALSQ当前投资价值的两种差异化纯量子计算架构。相关投资将与后量子密码、可信硬件和低温芯片整合，服务其“主权量子垂直栈”战略。
来源：
https://www.sealsq.com/investors/news-releases/sealsqs-24.5m-pure-play-quantum-computing-investments-and-collaborations-begin-generating-commercial-synergies
Diraq将在Equinix数据中心内部署量子计算机，加速量子计算商用
9月1日，Diraq和Equinix计划于2026年10月在悉尼的共享商业数据中心安装首台硅自旋量子计算机，使量子计算更接近大规模商业采用。此次部署这套八量子比特系统可与传统服务器兼容，功耗低于20千瓦，并通过芯片更换支持升级，无需改变周围基础设施。两家公司将在向潜在合作伙伴和客户展示之前，测试该系统与传统计算和人工智能基础设施的集成。
来源：
https://www.diraq.com/newsdesk/diraq-to-deploy-a-quantum-computer-inside-an-australian-equinix-data-centernbsp
熵函数完成数千万元天使轮融资，金沙江领投数千万元
9月1日，熵函数（深圳）科技有限公司（“熵函数”）近日成功完成数千万元天使轮融资。本轮融资由金沙江创投领投，沃赋创投、水木、海纳无限、零以创投等机构跟投。融资资金将主要用于量子算力运营平台核心能力建设、人才引进，加速落地工业级量子算力，提升对科研机构与产业用户的服务能力。
来源：
https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/sPMfGhRxs9oA5UHGA8bYqQ
Symmatrics发布人工智能与后量子准备承诺，推动行业准备
9月1日，Symmatrics已启动自愿性人工智能与后量子准备承诺，汇聚各组织，共同承诺采取更强加密韧性的措施。该承诺要求签署方清点加密资产，评估先采集后解密的风险，制定符合NIST标准的PQC迁移计划，与供应商合作，并向领导层或董事会报告进展。该倡议由10个创始签署方启动，并向更多组织开放，参与不意味着对Symmatrics技术的安全、合规性或认可。
来源：
https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/symmatrics-launches-ai--post-quantum-readiness-pledge-to-drive-industry-preparedness-302865553.html
Arqit、es'hailSat和AIEE展示量子安全卫星通信
9月1日，Arqit Quantum、Es'hailSat和AIEE在卡塔尔的卫星通信基础设施中展示了量子安全加密技术。此次演示将Arqit的加密技术整合进Es'hailSat位于多哈25.5/26°东经热点及Tier-4认证Teleport设施的实时卫星环境中。两家公司表示，测试显示可以在不中断系统、服务或运营性能的情况下，为现有卫星连接网络添加量子安全保护。
来源：
https://arqitgroup.com/resources/arqit-eshailsat-and-aiee-demonstrate-quantum-safe-satellite-security-1
QC Ware和IonQ展示高精度混合量子工作流程，用于药物发现
9月1日，QC Ware和IonQ展示了一种混合量子-经典化学工作流程，计算了细胞色素P450nor模型的静电相互作用能，精度在与经典基准值相差0.5 kcal/mol范围内。该工作流程结合了通过QC Ware的Promethium平台进行GPU加速预处理，以及通过Amazon Braket对IonQ的Forte离子阱系统的量子测量。该演示采用了八量子比特的主动空间模型，旨在评估混合量子化学工作流程如何支持药物发现及其他分子研究。
来源：
https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/qc-ware-and-ionq-demonstrate-high-precision-hybrid-quantum-workflow-for-drug-discovery-302866066.html
IonQ、NVIDIA和qBraid合作，在中路量子仿真中实现更低误差率
9月1日，IonQ、NVIDIA以及qBraid联合发表了一项研究，展示了用于深度Trotter化量子化学的应用原生错误缓解框架。研究团队在基于IonQ钡的开发系统（类似于即将推出的IonQ Tempo架构）上，配合GPU加速的经典计算，在6量子比特编码仿真步骤中，与直接物理Trotter执行相比，逻辑错误率降低了54%。
来源：
https://www.ionq.com/blog/a-platform-solution-to-the-deep-trotter-dilemma-improving-quantum-chemistry-simulations
Quobly与TNO签署备忘录，以加强硅自旋量子比特的工业化
9月2日，Quobly与TNO签署了一份备忘录，加强硅自旋量子比技术开发与工业化方面的技术合作。该合作结合了Quobly的300毫米FD-SOI平台与TNO在器件表征、材料分析和系统工程方面的专业知识。两家机构将致力于支持大规模集成和制造硅自旋量子比特所需的测量、仿真和高通量表征能力。
来源：
https://www.quobly.io/press-releases/quobly-and-tno-sign-mou-to-strengthen-the-industrialization-of-silicon-spin-qubits
PsiQuantum与布鲁克海文实验室合作，利用Construct软件工具加速量子应用开发
9月2日，PsiQuantum与布鲁克海文国家实验室合作，使用PsiQuantum的Construct软件平台，开展容错量子算法和科学应用的研究。布鲁克海文的研究人员将利用Construct开发和研究面向第一代容错量子计算机的算法。此次合作支持能源部的量子起源计划，目标是在2028年前开发并部署一套具有科学意义的容错量子计算系统。
来源：
https://www.psiquantum.com/news-import/psiquantum-brookhaven-lab-partner-to-accelerate-quantum-application-development-using-construct-software-tool
Pasqal和True Nexus
合作，
将量子计算应用于蛋白质胶化
9月2日，Pasqal和True Nexus利用Pasqal的中性原子量子技术编码了与蛋白质胶化分子机制相关的特定蛋白质结构。该合作结合了人工智能驱动的蛋白质分析与量子计算，研究蛋白质结构与功能之间的关系。两家公司表示，这项工作有望支持未来在食品和生物技术领域的应用，同时该项目也与沙特阿拉伯更广泛的应用量子技术计划相关联。
来源：
https://www.pasqal.com/newsroom/pasqal-and-true-nexus-open-a-new-quantum-frontier-for-the-global-protein-economy/
QuSecure在美国陆军融合项目Capstone 6上展示后量子安全
9月2日，QuSecure在美国陆军战术任务系统中展示了其QuProtect R3后量子密码学平台，参与了融合Capstone 6项目（PCC6）的演示。公司表示，QuProtect R3在陆军演习中实弹战术条件下运行后，达到了技术准备等级7。演示内容包括抗量子通信、密码学灵活性以及陆军战术网络的密码学发现和库存能力。
来源：
https://www.qusecure.com/qusecure-army-project-convergence-capstone-6-trl-7/
IBM Ventures宣布战略投资BQP，以扩展量子软件使用范围
9月2日，IBM Ventures宣布战略投资BQP，使其总融资达到800万美元，用于将其物理仿真平台扩展至航空航天和国防领域之外。BQP表示，自2025年种子轮以来，签约和承诺收入增长了八倍，客户基础增长了三倍，平台用户增长了二十倍。其BQPhy平台在现有CPU和GPU系统上运行物理和人工智能求解器，同时为客户未来的混合量子-经典计算做准备。
来源：
https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ibm-ventures-invests-in-bqp-as-quantum-algorithm-physics-acceleration-reaches-production-302867284.html
Cyprus与Greece建立量子安全卫星链路，保护通信免受威胁
9月2日，Cyprus和Greece利用Sparkle的量子安全互联（QSI）系统和Hellas Sat的卫星基础设施建立了首个量子安全卫星数据连接。该连接将Sparkle位于雅典的数据中心与Cyprus的Hellas Sat基础设施连接起来，数据通过卫星系统传输约72000公里。两家公司表示，此次试验展示了基于软件的量子安全保护如何应用于现有的地面和卫星网络，以应对“先采集”后解密“的风险。
来源：
https://cyprus-mail.com/2026/09/02/cyprus-takes-part-in-first-quantum-secure-satellite-link-with-greece
中原首个量子智算中心落地，由华立股份与上海图灵量子共建
9月2日，华立股份与上海图灵量子共建的华立股份量子智算中心在郑州正式启动。活动现场，图灵量子自研的光量子计算机完成交付，量子智慧水务联合实验室同步揭牌。据介绍，作为中原首个量子智算中心，双方将围绕多类水务场景深度探索量子计算、量子安全技术融合，打造“量子+水务”行业应用标杆。中心首批将聚焦智慧水务实际需求，未来中心还将逐步向生物医药、新材料、能源化工、金融等领域开放量子算力服务。
来源：

# Weekly Report | IBM Releases Nighthawk r2, the Fastest Quantum Processor to Date, Executing Over 100,000 Circuits per Second; Xanadu Updates Roadmap, Targeting More Than 1,000 Logical Qubits by 2031…

---

## IBM Releases Nighthawk r2, Executing Over 100,000 Circuits per Second

On August 31, IBM released Nighthawk r2, a 120-qubit processor and the fastest quantum processor to date. It incorporates a new qubit reset system designed to enable more valuable computation through dramatically accelerated qubit resets. The processor can execute more than 100,000 circuits per second—a throughput 25× that of IBM's Heron system—while maintaining comparable gate fidelity. Nighthawk r2 has demonstrated accurate estimation on circuits containing more than 7,500 gates and supports mid-circuit reset for quantum error correction research.

**Source:** https://www.ibm.com/quantum/blog/nighthawk-r2

---

## Xanadu Updates Technology Roadmap, Targeting More Than 1,000 Logical Qubits by 2031

On August 31, Xanadu released an updated technology roadmap targeting fault-tolerant quantum computing by 2028–2029 and more than 1,000 logical qubits by 2031. The roadmap aims to reduce the company's photon loss metric from 24.1× in 2026 to 1.0× by 2030, while achieving a logical error rate of 10⁻¹⁶. Xanadu also plans to build a quantum data center between 2029 and 2030 and to expand its PennyLane software platform to quantum hardware and simulation environments.

**Source:** https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/08/31/3353211/0/en/xanadu-charts-path-to-over-1-000-logical-qubits-by-2031.html

---

## U.S. Congressman Introduces the American Quantum Competitiveness Act

On August 31, Congressman Nick Langworthy introduced the American Quantum Competitiveness Act to strengthen U.S. quantum commercialization, manufacturing, and domestic supply chains. The legislation would designate the Department of Commerce as the lead federal agency for commercial quantum technology and require the development of a national competitiveness strategy. The bill emphasizes reducing dependence on foreign adversaries and supports advanced manufacturing along the New York I-90 technology corridor.

**Source:** https://langworthy.house.gov/media/press-releases/congressman-langworthy-introduces-american-quantum-competitiveness-act

---

## iAccess Partners and QAI Ventures Partner to Broaden Access to Quantum and Advanced Computing Ventures

On August 29, Swiss fintech firm iAccess Partners established a strategic partnership with Basel-based venture capital firm QAI Ventures to expand access to early-stage quantum technology and advanced computing investments. By leveraging bankable International Securities Identification Numbers (ISINs), the partnership lowers the minimum investment threshold for qualified and professional investors to USD 25,000.

**Source:** https://qai-ventures.com/news/qai-ventures-partners-with-iacess-partners

---

## Guoguang Quantum (国光量子) Secures Tens of Millions of RMB in Series A++ Round to Accelerate Photonic Integrated Quantum Computing

As announced on August 29, Beijing Zhongke Guoguang Quantum Technology Co., Ltd. (国光量子, Guoguang Quantum) recently closed a strategic financing round of tens of millions of RMB, led by a fund under the administrative committee of the Zhengzhou Airport Economy Zone, a national-level new area. The two parties will use photonic integrated quantum computing as their core focus to achieve deep synergy among technology, capital, and industrial resources, aligning with China's national quantum science and technology development strategy to accelerate core technology breakthroughs and deployment across multiple industry scenarios, and to co-build a quantum industry innovation ecosystem.

**Source:** https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/jNFVOxGxhQAkE_0yX3HEiQ

---

## Guoteng Quantum (国腾量子) Releases Fully Proprietary "Guangzongheng" Quantum Computer with Five-Layer System Architecture

On August 30, the 8th Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macao Greater Bay Area Quantum Cryptography and Information Security Summit Forum and the 5th Hong Kong and Macao Youth Elite Roundtable Forum were held in Guangzhou. At the event, Guangdong Guoteng Quantum Technology Co., Ltd. (广东国腾量子科技有限公司) officially launched its fully proprietary "Guangzongheng" (光纵横) quantum computer, featuring an entirely self-developed five-layer system architecture that achieves complete autonomy from underlying hardware to top-level applications. Simultaneously, the company unveiled the Quantum Jingwei Hub 829 Laboratory and launched the Q-Gate open-source community, forming a complete industry loop encompassing hardware foundation, system software, and development ecosystem.

**Source:** https://www.stdaily.com/web/gdxw/2026-08/30/content_572134.html

---

## Anyon Systems and KMT Technologies Announce Partnership to Expand Quantum Computing Deployment

On August 31, Anyon Systems and KMT Technologies established a strategic partnership to expand the international deployment of Anyon's superconducting quantum computing systems. KMT will serve as the exclusive agent and distributor for Anyon in select international markets, providing installation, integration, servicing, and support. The partnership combines Anyon's quantum computing technology with the Matrix Group's expertise in high-performance computing (HPC), AI infrastructure, data centers, networking, and systems integration.

**Source:** https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/anyon-systems-and-matrix-group-announce-strategic-partnership-to-accelerate-international-deployment-of-quantum-computing-302865069.html

---

## QTREX to Unveil 17,280-Line Cryogenic Interconnect Architecture at IEEE Quantum Week

On August 31, QTREX announced plans to unveil an ultra-high-density interconnect architecture at IEEE Quantum Week 2026, supporting up to 17,280 coaxial lines per cryogenic stage in full-scale commercial systems. The company will demonstrate a physical system reproducing architectural density across multiple temperature stages of a dilution refrigerator. Following the event, QTREX plans to launch configuration projects to develop interconnect systems tailored to specific quantum processor, cryostat, channel, thermal budget, and performance specifications.

**Source:** https://ir.q-trex.com/press-releases/qtex-20260831-correction-qtrex-establishes-cryogenic-interconnect-capacity

---

## Diffraqtion Announces Over $10 Million Raised to Accelerate Quantum Camera Development

On August 31, Diffraqtion announced strategic investments from Lockheed Martin Ventures and Presidio Ventures, bringing its total funding to more than USD 10 million. Diffraqtion, a spinout from MIT and the University of Maryland, has advanced its quantum camera technology through airborne demonstrations, a DARPA SBIR program, and NASA projects. The company plans to use the new funding to develop its first field camera, with the payload intended for integration on a partner spacecraft to establish flight heritage.

**Source:** https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/lockheed-martin-ventures-and-sumitomos-presidio-ventures-back-diffraqtion-302864959.html

## Pasqal and KACST Launch Collaboration Focused on Quantum and Post-Quantum Cryptography

On August 31, KACST (King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology) and Pasqal signed a research agreement to advance quantum technology research and develop quantum-safe cryptographic solutions in Saudi Arabia. The collaboration combines Pasqal's neutral-atom quantum computing technology and cloud services with KACST's National Quantum Technology Center, with a primary focus on quantum cryptography. The agreement extends Pasqal's presence in Saudi Arabia, following its collaboration with Aramco and a planned partnership with Eleven Ventures to deploy and commercialize quantum computing systems in Saudi Arabia and the broader MENA region.

**Source:** https://www.pasqal.com/newsroom/pasqal-and-kacst-launch-strategic-quantum-research-collaboration-as-pasqal-expands-presence-in-saudi-arabia/

## Quantinuum and Aramco Sign Non-Binding MOU to Explore Industrial Quantum Computing

On August 31, Quantinuum and Aramco signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding (MOU) to explore industrial applications of fault-tolerant quantum computing and potential research collaboration. The two companies plan to identify energy and digital transformation challenges suited to quantum computing research and to benchmark different quantum computing modalities. The agreement also encompasses technical onboarding and knowledge exchange, with Aramco evaluating how future quantum systems can address scientific and industrial problems.

**Source:** https://www.quantinuum.com/press-releases/quantinuum-signs-non-binding-mou-with-aramco-to-explore-synergies-leveraging-industrial-quantum-computing-research-applications-and-expertise

## S-Transistors Raises €2.6 Million Pre-Seed Round to Launch Superconducting Transistor Platform

On August 31, Finnish startup S-Transistors announced a €2.6 million pre-seed fundraise to develop superconducting transistor circuits aimed at enabling more efficient scaling of quantum computers. S-Transistors plans to develop product prototypes, establish a cryogenic laboratory and manufacturing pilot line, and expand its team. Its first product will be a multiplexer designed to reduce wiring and power requirements when controlling quantum devices in cryogenic systems.

**Source:** https://www.vttresearch.com/en/news-and-ideas/s-transistors-raises-eu26-million-pre-seed-round-introduce-unique-superconducting

---

## Yaqumo Selected for NEDO Program, to Collaborate with SCREEN Holdings on Domestic Optical Components and Modules

On August 31, Yaqumo was selected to participate in a NEDO (New Energy and Industrial Technology Development Organization) program and will collaborate with SCREEN Holdings to develop domestically produced optical components and modules for large-scale neutral-atom quantum computers. The project will focus on high-speed spatial light modulators, multi-wavelength objective lenses, environmentally stable optical components, and more compact systems utilizing photonic integrated circuits. Yaqumo plans to integrate the technology into its own systems while pursuing standardized modules for quantum computer developers in Japan and overseas.

**Source:** https://yaqumo.com/en/news/464/

---

## SEALSQ Discloses $24.5 Million Quantum Computing Investment Portfolio in Support of Sovereign Quantum Vertical Stack Strategy

On August 31, SEALSQ disclosed investments of approximately USD 17.5 million in Quobly, a French silicon-spin quantum company, and USD 7 million in EeroQ, a company pursuing an electronically levitated liquid helium approach. These assets represent approximately USD 24.5 million in strategic exposure across two differentiated pure-play quantum computing architectures, based on SEALSQ's current investment values. The investments will be integrated with post-quantum cryptography, trusted hardware, and cryogenic chip capabilities in service of its "sovereign quantum vertical stack" strategy.

**Source:** https://www.sealsq.com/investors/news-releases/sealsqs-24.5m-pure-play-quantum-computing-investments-and-collaborations-begin-generating-commercial-synergies

---

## Diraq to Deploy Quantum Computer Inside an Equinix Data Center to Accelerate Commercial Quantum Computing

On September 1, Diraq and Equinix announced plans to install the first silicon-spin quantum computer inside a shared commercial data center in Sydney in October 2026, bringing quantum computing closer to large-scale commercial adoption. The eight-qubit system is compatible with conventional servers, consumes less than 20 kW of power, and supports upgrades via chip replacement without changes to the surrounding infrastructure. The two companies will test integration of the system with classical computing and AI infrastructure before demonstrating it to potential partners and customers.

**Source:** https://www.diraq.com/newsdesk/diraq-to-deploy-a-quantum-computer-inside-an-australian-equinix-data-centernbsp

---

## Entropy Function (熵函数) Completes Angel Round of Tens of Millions of RMB, Led by GSR Ventures

On September 1, Entropy Function (Shenzhen) Technology Co., Ltd. (熵函数（深圳）科技有限公司) successfully completed an angel financing round of tens of millions of RMB. The round was led by GSR Ventures (金沙江创投), with participation from Wofu Ventures (沃赋创投), Shuimu, Haina Unlimited (海纳无限), and Zero-Yi Ventures (零以创投). The proceeds will be used primarily to build core capabilities of its quantum computing power operations platform, recruit talent, accelerate deployment of industrial-grade quantum computing power, and enhance service capacity for research institutions and industrial users.

**Source:** https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/sPMfGhRxs9oA5UHGA8bYqQ

---

## Symmatrics Launches AI and Post-Quantum Readiness Pledge to Drive Industry Preparedness

On September 1, Symmatrics launched a voluntary AI and Post-Quantum Readiness Pledge, bringing together organizations committed to adopting stronger cryptographic resilience measures. Signatories are required to inventory cryptographic assets, assess harvest-now-decrypt-later risks, develop PQC migration plans aligned with NIST standards, engage with vendors, and report progress to leadership or the board. The initiative launched with 10 founding signatories and is open to additional organizations; participation does not imply security endorsement, compliance certification, or approval of Symmatrics technology.

**Source:** https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/symmatrics-launches-ai--post-quantum-readiness-pledge-to-drive-industry-preparedness-302865553.html

---

## Arqit, Es'hailSat, and AIEE Demonstrate Quantum-Safe Satellite Communications

On September 1, Arqit Quantum, Es'hailSat, and AIEE demonstrated quantum-safe encryption technology within Qatar's satellite communications infrastructure. The demonstration integrated Arqit's encryption technology into Es'hailSat's live satellite environment at the 25.5/26° East hotspot in Doha and its Tier-4 certified Teleport facility. The two companies stated that testing showed it is possible to add quantum-safe protection to existing satellite connectivity networks without disrupting systems, services, or operational performance.

**Source:** https://arqitgroup.com/resources/arqit-eshailsat-and-aiee-demonstrate-quantum-safe-satellite-security-1

---

## QC Ware and IonQ Demonstrate High-Precision Hybrid Quantum Workflow for Drug Discovery

On September 1, QC Ware and IonQ demonstrated a hybrid quantum-classical chemistry workflow that computed the electrostatic interaction energy of a cytochrome P450nor model to within 0.5 kcal/mol of classical benchmark values. The workflow combines GPU-accelerated preprocessing via QC Ware's Promethium platform with quantum measurements on IonQ's Forte ion trap system via Amazon Braket. The demonstration employed an eight-qubit active-space model and was designed to evaluate how hybrid quantum chemistry workflows can support drug discovery and other molecular research.

**Source:** https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/qc-ware-and-ionq-demonstrate-high-precision-hybrid-quantum-workflow-for-drug-discovery-302866066.html

---

## IonQ, NVIDIA, and qBraid Collaborate to Achieve Lower Error Rates in Mid-Circuit Quantum Simulation

On September 1, IonQ, NVIDIA, and qBraid jointly published research demonstrating an application-native error mitigation framework for deep Trotterized quantum chemistry. The team achieved a 54% reduction in logical error rate compared to direct physical Trotter execution on six-qubit encoded simulation steps, using an IonQ barium-based development system (similar to the forthcoming IonQ Tempo architecture) together with GPU-accelerated classical computing.

**Source:** https://www.ionq.com/blog/a-platform-solution-to-the-deep-trotter-dilemma-improving-quantum-chemistry-simulations

---

## Quobly and TNO Sign MOU to Strengthen Industrialization of Silicon Spin Qubits

On September 2, Quobly and TNO (Netherlands Organisation for Applied Scientific Research) signed an MOU to strengthen technical collaboration on the development and industrialization of silicon spin qubit technology. The collaboration combines Quobly's 300 mm FD-SOI platform with TNO's expertise in device characterization, materials analysis, and systems engineering. The two institutions will work to develop measurement, simulation, and high-throughput characterization capabilities required for large-scale integration and manufacture of silicon spin qubits.

**Source:** https://www.quobly.io/press-releases/quobly-and-tno-sign-mou-to-strengthen-the-industrialization-of-silicon-spin-qubits

---

## PsiQuantum and Brookhaven National Laboratory Partner to Accelerate Quantum Application Development Using Construct Software Tool

On September 2, PsiQuantum and Brookhaven National Laboratory (BNL) partnered to conduct research on fault-tolerant quantum algorithms and scientific applications using PsiQuantum's Construct software platform. BNL researchers will use Construct to develop and study algorithms targeting first-generation fault-tolerant quantum computers. The collaboration supports the U.S. Department of Energy's Quantum Origins initiative, which aims to develop and deploy a scientifically meaningful fault-tolerant quantum computing system by 2028.

**Source:** https://www.psiquantum.com/news-import/psiquantum-brookhaven-lab-partner-to-accelerate-quantum-application-development-using-construct-software-tool

---

## Pasqal and True Nexus Collaborate to Apply Quantum Computing to Protein Gelation

On September 2, Pasqal and True Nexus used Pasqal's neutral-atom quantum technology to encode specific protein structures relevant to the molecular mechanisms of protein gelation. The collaboration combines AI-driven protein analysis with quantum computing to study structure–function relationships in proteins. The two companies stated that this work has the potential to support future applications in food and biotechnology, and that the project is linked to broader applied quantum technology initiatives in Saudi Arabia.

**Source:** https://www.pasqal.com/newsroom/pasqal-and-true-nexus-open-a-new-quantum-frontier-for-the-global-protein-economy/

---

## QuSecure Demonstrates Post-Quantum Security at U.S. Army Project Convergence Capstone 6

On September 2, QuSecure demonstrated its QuProtect R3 post-quantum cryptography platform on U.S. Army tactical mission systems as part of Project Convergence Capstone 6 (PCC6). The company stated that QuProtect R3 achieved Technology Readiness Level 7 after operating under live-fire tactical conditions during Army exercises. The demonstration included quantum-resistant communications, cryptographic agility, and cryptographic discovery and inventory capabilities for Army tactical networks.

**Source:** https://www.qusecure.com/qusecure-army-project-convergence-capstone-6-trl-7/

---

## IBM Ventures Announces Strategic Investment in BQP to Expand Quantum Software Reach

On September 2, IBM Ventures announced a strategic investment in BQP, bringing its total funding to USD 8 million to expand its physics simulation platform beyond aerospace and defense. BQP reported that signed and committed revenue has grown eightfold, its customer base has tripled, and platform users have grown twentyfold since its 2025 seed round. Its BQPhy platform runs physics and AI solvers on existing CPU and GPU systems while preparing customers for future hybrid quantum-classical computing.

**Source:** https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ibm-ventures-invests-in-bqp-as-quantum-algorithm-physics-acceleration-reaches-production-302867284.html

---

## Cyprus and Greece Establish Quantum-Safe Satellite Link to Protect Communications

On September 2, Cyprus and Greece established the first quantum-safe satellite data connection using Sparkle's Quantum Safe Interconnect (QSI) system and Hellas Sat's satellite infrastructure. The link connects Sparkle's data center in Athens with Hellas Sat infrastructure in Cyprus, transmitting data approximately 72,000 km through the satellite system. The two companies stated that the trial demonstrated how software-based quantum-safe protection can be applied to existing terrestrial and satellite networks to address harvest-now-decrypt-later risks.

**Source:** https://cyprus-mail.com/2026/09/02/cyprus-takes-part-in-first-quantum-secure-satellite-link-with-greece

---

## Central China's First Quantum Intelligent Computing Center Launched, Co-Built by Huali Shares and Shanghai Turing Quantum

On September 2, the Huali Shares Quantum Intelligent Computing Center, co-built by Huali Shares (华立股份) and Shanghai Turing Quantum (上海图灵量子), was officially inaugurated in Zhengzhou. At the launch event, Turing Quantum's proprietary photonic quantum computer was delivered, and the Quantum Smart Water Joint Laboratory was simultaneously unveiled. Described as Central China's first quantum intelligent computing center, the two parties will deeply explore the integration of quantum computing and quantum security technologies across multiple water utility scenarios, establishing a benchmark for "quantum + water utility" industry applications. The center will initially focus on smart water utility needs, with plans to gradually expand quantum computing services to biopharmaceuticals, new materials, energy chemicals, and finance.

**Source:** https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/KGjeSq8w-9ypDGmsSwPr6A

---

## SEEQC Signs MOU with Taiwan Quantum Industry Technology Promotion Office to Advance Quantum Collaboration

On September 2, SEEQC announced the signing of an MOU with the Taiwan Quantum Industry Technology Promotion Office to expand cooperation and exchange across quantum technologies and the emerging global quantum supply chain. The agreement establishes a collaborative framework between SEEQC and Taiwan's quantum ecosystem spanning technology development, product development, manufacturing, testing and verification, commercialization, and supply chain development. Under the MOU, both parties may also facilitate connections between SEEQC and relevant Taiwanese companies, research institutions, and technology capabilities, supporting technology exchange, commercial cooperation, joint development, and other potential areas of collaboration.

**Source:** https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260902558663/en/SEEQC-Signs-MOU-with-Taiwan-Quantum-Industry-Technology-Promotion-Office-to-Advance-Quantum-Collaboration

---

## Quobly and Orange Quantum Systems Sign MOU to Advance Automated Testing of Silicon Spin Qubits

On September 2, Quobly and Orange Quantum Systems (OrangeQS) signed an MOU to develop automated, high-throughput testing and characterization capabilities for silicon spin qubit devices. The collaboration combines Quobly's 300 mm FD-SOI silicon spin qubit platform with OrangeQS's automated diagnostics, measurement protocols, and test systems for solid-state quantum chips. The partners aim to develop scalable testing methodologies to measure device performance and variability as silicon spin qubit processors progress toward industrial manufacturing.

**Source:** https://www.quobly.io/press-releases/quobly-and-orange-quantum-systems-sign-mou-to-advance-automated-testing-of-silicon-spin-qubits

---

## Kensho and Classiq Partner to Accelerate Quantum Software Adoption in Taiwan

On September 2, Kensho and Classiq established a market development partnership to expand access to Classiq's quantum software platform in Taiwan. Kensho will promote the platform to government agencies, research institutions, and enterprises while providing local support, training, and exploring joint R&D opportunities. The collaboration will initially target chemical and materials companies, defense organizations, and other groups evaluating quantum computing for simulation and optimization.

**Source:** https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/02/3355583/0/en/scientek-and-classiq-partner-to-accelerate-quantum-software-adoption-in-taiwan.html

## SEALSQ and wolfSSL Partner to Add wolfTPM Support for QVault Post-Quantum TPM

On September 3, SEALSQ and wolfSSL announced native support for SEALSQ's QVault TPM hardware security chip, adding software support for post-quantum algorithms implemented in TPM hardware. The integration supports ML-DSA, Hash-ML-DSA, and ML-KEM parameter sets, with testing available on physical QVault hardware and within wolfSSL's TPM firmware environment. wolfTPM includes dedicated QVault support, new tools, post-quantum examples, build instructions, and hardware benchmarks for embedded development.

**Source:** https://www.sealsq.com/investors/news-releases/sealsq-announces-wolftpm-support-for-its-post-quantum-tpm-technology

## Quantum Motion Secures Additional Investment to Accelerate Scalable Silicon Quantum Computing

On September 3, Quantum Motion announced the second close of its Series C financing round, with new investment from Imec.ventures, Lansdowne Partners, Sony Innovation Fund, S3 Ventures, and Inkef. The funds will support silicon quantum computing development, custom silicon co-development, semiconductor manufacturing partnerships, and the company's international expansion, including its new U.S. laboratory in Maryland. Quantum Motion targets fault-tolerant quantum hardware based on silicon CMOS manufacturing and is participating in Phase B of the DARPA Quantum Benchmarking program.

**Source:** https://quantummotion.com/quantum-motion-secures-additional-investment-to-accelerate-scalable-silicon-quantum-computing/

## Jülich and eleQtron Jointly Launch JION Ion Trap Quantum Computer

On September 3, Forschungszentrum Jülich (Jülich Research Centre) and Siegen-based startup eleQtron officially inaugurated the JION quantum computer. JION will be made accessible to research institutions and industry through the JUNIQ user infrastructure, enabling hybrid computing with Jülich's supercomputers.
